scope: Substantive screening of the actual current 199 candidate texts and inherited dependencies; no exhaustive worldwide patent search, no filing readiness certification, no applicant experiments or experimental program.
historical_novelty_flags: Preserve novelty_assessed=false in historical maps. This newer audit records screen_complete separately from statutory_determination=unresolved.
review_standard: Each record preserves exact current text, direct/transitive parents, additional feature and mapped paragraphs. Family assessment references group repeated reasons, not legal outcomes.

legal_sources.title: USPTO MPEP 2131, 2131.02 and 2131.03
legal_sources.principle: Anticipation compares each limitation as arranged with a qualifying single reference, including express or necessary inherent disclosure. A known species can anticipate a broad genus. A vast generic domain does not necessarily disclose each selected species; bounded combinations, clear named species and range specificity matter.

legal_sources.title: USPTO MPEP 2112
legal_sources.principle: Inherency requires necessity supported by evidence or sound technical reasoning, not a possible or likely response.

legal_sources.title: USPTO MPEP 2121
legal_sources.principle: Reference enablement considers the teaching with skilled knowledge and is distinct from enabling an applicant claim's full breadth; actual reference-author experiments are not categorically required.

legal_sources.title: USPTO MPEP 2143
legal_sources.principle: Obviousness needs a reasoned comparison of differences, relevant teachings, rationale and reasonable expectation of success, with contrary evidence assessed.

legal_sources.title: USPTO MPEP 2144.05 and 2144.08
legal_sources.principle: Overlapping ranges, result-effective variables and genus/species selection require factual review. Routine optimization is not an automatic consequence of listing every numerical possibility; very broad dissimilar domains can alter that inquiry.

legal_sources.title: USPTO MPEP 2163
legal_sources.principle: Textual mapping and original claim wording do not conclusively establish written description. Possession of the claimed subject matter and combination is a separate factual inquiry from enablement; a menu can fail to describe a particular later species.

legal_sources.title: USPTO MPEP 2164
legal_sources.principle: Full-scope enablement permits reasonable experimentation under the Wands factors. Prophetic examples can contribute without applicant experiments, but must remain identifiable as unperformed and must not substitute a research program for usable teaching.

legal_sources.title: USPTO MPEP 2106
legal_sources.principle: Statutory category and judicial exceptions are separate. Mathematical/mental operations and nature-based products require claim-as-a-whole analysis, including practical integration or significantly more; technical improvement must be supported in the specification and reflected in the claim.

legal_sources.title: USPTO Dec 5 2025 Desjardins advance MPEP update
legal_sources.principle: The immediately effective technological-improvement guidance supplements the MPEP. Data structures or applied computation can be eligible where the claimed whole provides a described technology/computer improvement; usefulness of information or generic automation alone does not certify eligibility.

legal_sources.title: USPTO Apr 30 2026 SMED best practices
legal_sources.principle: April30 best practices supersede December4 applicant/practitioner best practices and are supplemented by September29 (L20). They do not replace the separate December4 examiner memorandum. No executed eligibility declaration is supplied by this review.

legal_sources.title: USPTO MPEP 2173
legal_sources.principle: Breadth alone is not indefiniteness. Ambiguous specimen boundaries, terms, contradictory inheritance or uncertain protected scope warrant separate review.

legal_sources.title: USPTO MPEP 608.01(m),(n)
legal_sources.principle: Dependent claims incorporate all parent limitations and must further limit them; duplicate claims and unclear terminology raise drafting questions. A valid reference graph does not decide substance.

legal_sources.title: WIPO PCT Rule 13
legal_sources.principle: Unity requires one invention or a single general inventive concept linked by the same or corresponding special technical features defining contribution over the art. Formal dependency or a shared catalog vocabulary does not guarantee that link.

legal_sources.title: WIPO PCT ISPE Guidelines PCT/GL/ISPE/14 effective Jan 1 2026
legal_sources.principle: Current chapter 10 allows a priori and a posteriori unity review; loss of a common contribution over prior art can leave dependent inventions without unity. International search/preliminary examination does not itself grant worldwide patent rights.

legal_sources.title: USPTO Nov 26 2025 revised AI-assisted inventorship guidance
legal_sources.principle: This guidance rescinds February 2024 guidance in its entirety. Ordinary human conception standards apply with or without AI; only natural persons are inventors and AI systems are tools. User-directed review naming is not claim-specific conception evidence.

legal_sources.title: USPTO MPEP 211, provisional benefit
legal_sources.principle: A later claim's provisional benefit needs adequate written description/enablement of that subject matter and procedural entitlement. Optional broad provisional claims or preparation dates alone do not establish priority.

legal_sources.title: USPTO MPEP 2128, printed-publication accessibility
legal_sources.principle: Public accessibility, version contents and dates govern printed-publication analysis; private commits and file preparation dates do not establish earliest public availability.

legal_sources.title: USPTO MPEP 2107, utility
legal_sources.principle: Specific, substantial and credible utility and operability should be assessed separately. An index can be useful even where the corresponding hypothetical physical material has no supported production or use.

legal_sources.title: USPTO MPEP 2117, Markush groupings
legal_sources.principle: Alternative chemical groupings raise shared-structure/common-use questions distinct from indefiniteness and enablement. This claim set is not assumed improper solely because its domain is large.

legal_sources.title: USPTO September 29 2026 SMED addendum: flowchart and best practices
legal_sources.inspection: All four pages text-inspected on 3 October 2026.
legal_sources.principle: This addendum supplements April2026, leaves the December4 examiner memorandum unchanged and announces no new practice. SMED submission remains optional; eligibility evidence can be addressed separately from novelty, obviousness and disclosure.

legal_sources.title: USPTO Evaluating SMEDs flowchart
legal_sources.principle: Formality review precedes merits review. Objective evidence needs a sufficient connection to the claim and is weighed with the full record; evidence cannot supply information required in the original disclosure. This package supplies no executed SMED.

ALLOY.scope: CoCrFeNi/CoCrFeMnNi principal equiatomic feeds, prepared specimens and reported local impurities; complete support and exact equality remain conditional.

GLASS.scope: Selected metallic-glass source/route and six-principal target; present fine-box and below-floor models are current calculations, not source specimen data.

OXIDE.scope: TiO2(B) nominal 1:2 formula, selected nanosheet route; retained surfaces/residuals, source-specific precursor issues and exact binary closure remain qualified.

POLYMER.scope: Su et al. PLLA/PDLA 1:1 feed blend and ideal repeat/conditional chain-end record. Feed mass and nominal repeats are not complete incorporated composition, sequence or topology; source Mn/PDI assignment remains dimensionally unresolved.

HYDROGEL.scope: Source-local PIC/linker operations and response context; present count/topology/record examples remain calculated/proposed.

ELECTRICAL.scope: SWCNT/PEDOT:PSS/PS stock origins, source preparation and percolation context; stock-component targets are not elemental fractions or performed source specimen compositions.

MOLECULAR.scope: Attributed carbamazepine selected connectivity/hydrate source; bulk isolation/mixture proportions and exact retained inventory not established here.

COMPOSITE.scope: Attributed nanotube/epoxy example; loading, constituent identity and whole retained elemental/volume inventory differ.

NUCLEAR.scope: Dated nuclear identifiers/evaluation fields, not an arbitrary isotope material or current/future complete nuclear universe.

PARTICLE.scope: Selected identity/property source locators include searches/limits; table inclusion is not discovery or full system-record implementation.

comparator_review_limit: Comparators are selected curated repository records and their cited primary sources; this review is not an exhaustive worldwide patent search or a new inspection of every native scientific-source graphic.

common_assessments.textual_support: Mapped numerical/accounting/descriptor text is present, but textual correspondence is not legal written-description possession of every claimed physical embodiment. Current [0081]-[0094] supplement finite conditional models and failure boundaries; they do not automatically narrow these unchanged claims or backdate them.
common_assessments.material_enablement: Screen complete: full claimed physical scope is not demonstrated as enabled. Missing production/retention, structure/state, preparation applicability, observability and useful operation are identified by family. Adequate literature/theory/skilled knowledge can contribute without applicant experiments; absent evidence remains absent.
common_assessments.record_enablement: Screen complete for the scope actually claimed: operations write/select/calculate records; they do not require making every indexed material or producing every particle. The description provides mathematics and schema, with selected performed curation records. Missing full-workflow/implementation demonstrations are stated rather than inferred from partial generators.
common_assessments.material_eligibility: A physical material can fall in manufacture/composition-of-matter categories. Current unrestricted claims can include naturally occurring products; any nature-based product branch requires claim-as-a-whole analysis of markedly different characteristics/practical integration. Unavailable hypothetical constituents raise utility/enablement concerns without an automatic abstract-idea finding.
common_assessments.record_eligibility: Record selection, normalization, enumeration, status classification and hypothesis recording implicate mathematical concepts or mental/informational processes. Current claims recite no particular computer, operative fabrication/control step or clearly identified computer improvement. Apply current MPEP plus Desjardins guidance to the whole; the useful record alone is no eligibility certificate.
common_assessments.material_unity: Screen complete: broad elemental accounting alone is not demonstrated as a special technical contribution shared across alloys, molecules, polymers, isotopes, phases and arbitrary hypothetical materials. Common claim 1 inheritance does not resolve PCT unity or domestic restriction; selected physical inventions may require grouping after prior-art review.
common_assessments.record_unity: Screen complete: a possible common record workflow is described, but no established special technical feature over prior art links all numerical, particle and scenario methods to all physical materials. Independent particle method194 and material method186 must be separately analyzed; formal dependent structure is insufficient.
common_assessments.inventorship: Robert M. Layne remains the user-directed proposed sole inventor for review. Claim-specific human conception history, dates, contributor acts and derivation/source boundaries are not supplied. Source authors' findings are not applicant discoveries; AI drafting/calculation is a tool. This dimension is reviewed but legally unresolved under the ordinary human conception standard.
common_assessments.chronology: Candidate effective filing date, actual filing/benefit entitlement, source qualification/exceptions and earliest public-version date remain unresolved. Recorded article dates, preparation dates and public access observations are kept distinct.

families.name: Variable complete elemental inventory
families.enablement: The simplex defines targets but supplies no general preparation/use route for arbitrary recognized/hypothetical mixtures. [0082]-[0083] show retention and phase-profile constraints rather than a universal process.
families.novelty: On the complete-actual-support construction, finite recognized-element specimens with at least two elements necessarily have positive normalized atom counts and zeros outside their actual support. Enabled alloy/glass/oxide/polymer/composite species therefore present strong conditional anticipation exposure; 'selected' and 'expressly identified' need construction.
families.obviousness: Identify any actual physical difference after inventory/basis construction. Pure enumeration or a different descriptive record is not itself a supported materials advance; no completed motivation/expectation analysis is supplied.
families.definiteness: Resolve whether inventory is a fixed constituent list or all actual positive counts, specimen region/time, and whether 'expressly identified' restricts the product or only its description. 'Comprising' and closed elemental denominator should be explained together.
families.action: Retain the broad scope as a review catalog; add express construction alternatives, specimen/time boundary and source-limitation charts. Reserve any narrower future material claim for a selected supported physical embodiment.

families.name: Exact counts 2 through 118
families.enablement: Exact k supplies a cardinality, not compatible chemistry, preparation, structure, retained inventory or use. Every such claim still permits some hypothetical labels and arbitrary fractions.
families.novelty: For each exact k, all k actual constituents must be considered; principal-name counts alone do not settle closure. Concrete comparisons exist for k=2,3,4,5,6,7 with impurity/retention qualifications. For other k this review has no demonstrated exact-k comparator.
families.obviousness: Count selection alone supplies no chemistry-specific reason, success expectation or unexpected result. Evaluate the particular permitted species and all inherited requirements.
families.definiteness: The integer count is clear, but inherits claim 1's inventory/basis ambiguity. Do not substitute k principal ingredients for k actual elements.
families.action: For each k retain exact count and explicitly identify whether a cited specimen establishes complete support, principal target only or unsupported hypothetical branch.

families.name: Exact counts above 118
families.enablement: With only 118 recognized labels, k>118 necessarily requires at least k-118 unconfirmed labels. No route producing or retaining these entities in a material is provided; this is not routine chemical preparation.
families.novelty: No enabled comparator for the required hypothetical-constituent material is established here. This absence is not a novelty conclusion, and unperformed enumeration does not disclose an enabled species.
families.obviousness: No demonstrated production route or reasonable expectation of making the required unconfirmed constituents supports an obviousness conclusion. Mathematical cardinality is not a success expectation.
families.definiteness: k is numerically clear; hypothetical identifiers retain status. The claim describes a physical material rather than merely an index.
families.action: Keep as expressly unsupported physical scope, specifying the minimum unconfirmed constituent count; distinguish indexing utility from material utility.

families.name: Independent unary materials
families.enablement: Normalized (1) is complete accounting but does not teach every pure element form, isotope population, allotrope, preparation or useful hypothetical element.
families.novelty: Recognized unary forms are a direct prior-art search target; exact outside-zero versus idealized source teaching needs construction. No all-unary novelty conclusion follows from omission of a named comparator.
families.obviousness: Purification, allotrope and isolation teachings would need specific comparisons. No required structure or process distinguishes this claim.
families.definiteness: Absolute outside-zero needs a specimen boundary and status distinct from nondetection. Natural versus manufactured form is not specified.
families.action: Add source-grounded unary illustrative records with explicit form, inventory/purity convention and utility; retain unknown hypothetical branches.

families.name: Recognized-only multi-element materials
families.enablement: Removing hypothetical labels leaves highly unpredictable arbitrary recognized-element chemistry; it does not supply a universal preparation.
families.novelty: Ordinary recognized-element species in existing family charts fall within this branch on the actual-support construction; full assay is not categorically needed for that accounting argument.
families.obviousness: Settle any remaining difference rather than assert recognized-label selection itself is inventive.
families.definiteness: Label boundary 1-118 is precise; inherited specimen/declaration construction remains open.
families.action: Record the recognized-only branch as more physically grounded than 141, while preserving its breadth and conditional prior-species exposure.

families.name: At least one unconfirmed element
families.enablement: At least one 119-138 label requires unavailable production/retention/use teaching in this record.
families.novelty: Existing recognized-material papers do not establish this positive hypothetical label. No completed novelty finding follows.
families.obviousness: No reasoned expectation of making the required unconfirmed constituent is established.
families.definiteness: 'At least one' is clear but physical existence is expressly unresolved.
families.action: State the missing production, state, lifetime, retention and utility dependencies as unsupported; do not assign default properties.

families.name: All 118 recognized elements
families.enablement: Recognition of element identities does not establish all-element coexistence, stocks, lifetimes, retained inventory or preparation.
families.novelty: No complete 118-element physical species comparator is identified in the reviewed charts; the nominal count alone is not novelty evidence.
families.obviousness: Any combination rationale must address incompatibility, short lifetimes and retention across all 118; no such supported analysis exists.
families.definiteness: k=118 and all recognized labels is a precise support, but basis/time/phase remain broad.
families.action: Keep the complete recognized support explicit and record omitted coexistence and preparation evidence.

families.name: All 138 labels
families.enablement: Includes all twenty hypothetical labels plus unsupported coexistence/retention of the complete inventory.
families.novelty: No enabling all-138 species comparator is established; this is the same physical breadth as claim 138 under the distinct-inventory definition.
families.obviousness: No production/combination rationale establishes success for all 138.
families.definiteness: All 138 distinct labels selected from a 138-label vocabulary follows already from claim 138; substantial duplicate issue.
families.action: Flag duplication with 138 for a later reviewed claim version; preserve the present numbered annex and unsupported status.

families.name: Atomic and mole-of-atoms basis
families.enablement: Correct basis definitions improve accounting but cannot make every parent material; actual finite inventory and route remain unresolved.
families.novelty: Atom-count fractions and mole-of-atoms normalization on the same inventory are accounting relations, exposing these broad branches to existing recognized species under the chosen construction.
families.obviousness: A basis relabeling or normalization identity is not a demonstrated physical difference; investigate any functional implementation separately.
families.definiteness: 144 selects atoms; 145 must keep the same atom inventory, excluding molecules/formula-unit/feed molarity.
families.action: Supply finite-boundary atom-count examples and expressly separate formula-unit and feed bases.

families.name: Mass basis
families.enablement: Mass allocation must be compatible with isotope/state and specimen conventions; unknown hypothetical positive-population masses prevent conversion.
families.novelty: A mass description of known material may overlap the claim without a new physical product. Existing charts do not provide a full retained mass vector.
families.obviousness: Any inventive weight cannot be presumed from choosing the mass basis; compare actual mass allocation/function and material differences.
families.definiteness: Elemental mass allocation and common denominator must be specified; mass and atomic equality differ.
families.action: Keep explicit effective masses/allocation and unresolved input masses, rather than convert nominal ratios by unstated standard weights.

families.name: Qualified atomic/mass conversion
families.enablement: The equations are technically described under positive finite isotope-qualified masses and allocation. They do not establish availability, phases or synthesis.
families.novelty: Conventional mass/atomic conversion is a comparator target; this audit supplies no complete earlier arrangement qualifying each stated convention.
families.obviousness: Routine conversion may be relevant, but a cited teaching and reasoned application are needed; equations alone do not create a new material.
families.definiteness: Current wording selects x=a or w by basis and resolves the earlier x ambiguity; retain units/state/binding allocation.
families.action: Retain corrected equations and give one supported known-mass example plus an explicit blocked unknown-positive-mass case.

families.name: Unrestricted rational and primitive fractions
families.enablement: Finite atomic inventories imply rational fractions, but arbitrary numerators do not produce a physical material; mass rationality is a separate assumption.
families.novelty: On an atomic branch finite recognized specimens necessarily yield a rational vector reducible to primitive form; inherited construction still matters. Primitive representation is principally descriptive.
families.obviousness: Reducing a common denominator is a mathematics target for comparison, not demonstrated new chemistry.
families.definiteness: q is a representational denominator, not automatically specimen N. Mass fractions do not automatically equal integer atom counts.
families.action: Add primitive denominator versus compatible N examples and distinguish representational selection from physical limitation.

families.name: Fixed D-grid and extreme trace distributions
families.enablement: D=10^19 is accounting resolution; control/detection of 1/D retained fractions and absence of all outside constituents remain unsupported across scope.
families.novelty: Fixed-grid membership does not follow from arbitrary finite counts. 151 further demands k-1 exact trace entries; nominal stock values do not establish it.
families.obviousness: Any trace-selection or purity optimization requires specific prior ranges, purpose, route and expectation; no blanket grid-obviousness conclusion.
families.definiteness: Keep D separate from atom inventory N and exact target from measured tolerance; 151 inherits all 150/1 requirements.
families.action: Print exact integer/count compatibility and reject using a denominator witness as preparation or assay.

families.name: Positive correlated decimal intervals
families.enablement: Box feasibility teaches arithmetic; it does not establish preparation or properties throughout the correlated box.
families.novelty: 152 permits [0,1] for each coordinate; 153 and 154 permit p=0 and the whole [0,1] elementary cell. These choices impose no added composition restriction. Specific narrower endpoints need separate comparison.
families.obviousness: A meaningful range argument requires actual material, overlapping source range and reason to select/optimize; enumeration of every range is insufficient.
families.definiteness: Endpoints and normalization are clear; nonrestrictive allowable choices and physical versus descriptive interval language need attention.
families.action: Flag p=0/nonrestrictive alternatives and keep exact correlated feasibility; for a later narrowing version choose supported endpoint values.

families.name: Binary complements
families.enablement: Complementary bookkeeping is correct only on one closed two-element denominator; retained physical realization remains open.
families.novelty: Variable L,U can cover ordinary binary species. x_B=1-x_A is necessary for normalized binary accounting, not a new property.
families.obviousness: Compare the selected binary chemistry and range; complement notation alone supplies no inventive physical difference.
families.definiteness: The complement is correlated, not independently selectable. L,U feasibility and the same basis must be maintained.
families.action: Keep a named binary target separate from a source's incomplete whole product, and preserve exact complement semantics.

families.name: Exact ultratrace endpoints and subranges
families.enablement: No validated incorporation/assay at 10^-18 through 10^-17 fraction is supplied. 157/158 demand exact endpoints; 159/160 demand integer-grid selections and all binary closure requirements.
families.novelty: No reviewed physical comparator establishes these exact retained trace values; arithmetic 91-point coverage does not decide novelty. All inherited 155/1 features remain relevant.
families.obviousness: Purity/doping motivation, result-effective variable, achievable route and expected success would need actual teachings; trace indexing does not supply them.
families.definiteness: Fraction-to-percent conversion is correct; exact point and interval uncertainty cannot be exchanged.
families.action: Keep each exact endpoint/subrange explicit and add contamination, sampling/count compatibility and detection failure boundaries as unresolved.

families.name: Equal and 1:2 ratios
families.enablement: Nominal stoichiometry/equiatomic feed does not prove exact whole-product ratio, impurities, structures or preparation for every allowed pair/support.
families.novelty: 161 is binary half/half; 162 is binary 1/3,2/3; 163 is each 1/k. TiO2 formula and equiatomic alloy teachings are concrete comparison targets, but exact complete inventory remains qualified.
families.obviousness: Selected stoichiometry/ranges need material-specific sources and rationale. Equality alone supplies no unexpected-results evidence.
families.definiteness: Atomic versus mass equality must be resolved; 163 does not inherit an exact-k claim.
families.action: Preserve independent dependency branches and full denominator; do not call a 1:1 polymer blend a binary-element 50/50 product.

families.name: Above or below 10^-19 threshold
families.enablement: The threshold is not a physical minimum; N-dependent discreteness, incorporation, mass allocation and assay remain unsolved.
families.novelty: 164 can cover many conventional compositions; 165 requires a particular positive below-floor constituent. A current stipulated trace coordinate is not a source specimen.
families.obviousness: A physical reason and achievable expected modification across the threshold must be supported; no arbitrary-threshold inventiveness follows.
families.definiteness: 164 requires every constituent >= floor; 165 at least one below. Neither is equivalent to D-grid membership.
families.action: Distinguish source principal target, calculated below-floor model and actual complete inventory.

families.name: Refined rational or real intervals
families.enablement: Refinement creates addresses rather than attainable precision. An exact finite atomic vector is rational; real target endpoints need not require irrational atom fractions.
families.novelty: 167/168 allow [0,1] and rational/real endpoints respectively; 168 includes rational endpoints. 166 has its specific single-cell width, not every fine box.
families.obviousness: Specific range/selection rationale depends on the underlying material and art; infinite endpoints do not prove obviousness or novelty.
families.definiteness: 166's e,r,j restrictions are real limitations; 168 does not require irrationality. Symbolic real targets and finite specimens differ.
families.action: Provide one matched and one excluded refined cell, preserve exact arithmetic and label real endpoints symbolic.

families.name: Isotope/state profiles
families.enablement: Correct current mass/atomic equations do not establish requested state production, enrichment, lifetimes or preparation; [0090] limits mixtures to supported stock profiles.
families.novelty: Source isotope tables supply identities/qualified properties, not every state-populated material. 170 pure conditional state, 171 multiple positive states and 172 state identifier are separate limitations.
families.obviousness: Enrichment/mixing/state choice needs actual available stocks, separation/production teaching and expectation; no generic isotope-menu conclusion.
families.definiteness: 169's basis correction is already present. Unknown masses only for positively populated entries block mass conversion; 'source-qualified' identifier and observation boundary need definition.
families.action: Retain corrected equations; specify state/status/time, supported stock convex hull and a requested missing-state rejection.

families.name: Timed decay with daughter inventory
families.enablement: Snapshot and daughter accounting are described; no arbitrary radioactive mixture's production or persistence follows.
families.novelty: A particular decay/source inventory may contain necessary daughters; only retained products in the selected denominator qualify. No actual full match is established here.
families.obviousness: A decay model and retention/time conditions must support the claimed snapshot; a list of nuclides cannot supply these.
families.definiteness: Claim 1's outside-zero closure must be applied at the stated time; daughters may change support and k.
families.action: Add explicit retained/escaped daughter boundaries, time qualification and source-labelled kinetic assumptions.

families.name: Crystal model, occupations and charge balance
families.enablement: General instructions and selected oxide/alloy reports do not teach arbitrary site/substitution/charge-constrained phases; [0085] demonstrates only atom balance under assumptions.
families.novelty: No structural values are fixed. Existing crystal reports are substantial comparison targets, while composition labels alone do not prove full model/site mapping.
families.obviousness: Actual substitutions, charge compensation, phase stability and expectation need system-specific teachings.
families.definiteness: 'Specified' must restrict an actual structural arrangement or identify required record relationship; unconstrained descriptors may be informational.
families.action: Give selected phase model, allowed occupancy/charge ranges and realistic competing structures with status labels.

families.name: Amorphous phase and characterization convention
families.enablement: Preparation history and detection convention do not establish every amorphous material or a universal crystallization threshold; [0084] is conditional.
families.novelty: Glass source has concrete preparation/diagnostic overlap; unknown measured fraction does not prove novelty. No particular amorphous fraction threshold is claimed.
families.obviousness: Cooling, nucleation and quenching rationale/expectation require local history and supported phase evidence.
families.definiteness: Current claim requires a characterization convention for detectable crystalline fraction, not a numeric fraction or universally zero crystallinity.
families.action: Keep source-specific route and resolution boundaries; label residence-window model conditional and do not invent a critical cooling rate.

families.name: Connectivity, stereochemistry, salt/solvate and hydration
families.enablement: Carbamazepine source supports selected identities; [0086] counts ideal separate phases but does not enable arbitrary molecule/solvate or bulk isolated mixtures.
families.novelty: Known molecular identities are direct comparator targets. Elemental formula alone cannot anticipate additional selected connectivity/state.
families.obviousness: Specific reaction, isolation and conversion expectations matter; all permitted isomers/salts cannot be inferred from one formula.
families.definiteness: Where-present qualifications need objective applicability; unspecified identity descriptors can be a generic documentation requirement.
families.action: Preserve exact formulas/connectivity, sampled crystallite versus bulk product boundary and hydration/polymorph failure branches.

families.name: Polymer incorporated/sequence/MWD/network specification
families.enablement: Repeat/chain-end calculations and averages do not establish every sequence, chain distribution or network. [0087]-[0088] explicitly leave ends, topology and load-bearing bridge effectiveness open.
families.novelty: PLLA/PDLA and PIC/linker sources are selected comparison targets; feed ratios do not establish all current incorporated/sequence/MWD/network limitations.
families.obviousness: A modification rationale requires actual chain/sequence/topology control and expected response; crosslinker amount alone is insufficient.
families.definiteness: 'Specified by' may indicate actual physical restrictions or descriptive fields. Mean molecular weights do not specify the entire distribution.
families.action: Add chain counts/end models, incorporated ratios and topology alternatives; preserve measured, calculated and unsupported distinctions.

families.name: Composite geometry/interfaces/dispersion
families.enablement: Nominal loading and orientation tensor do not establish complete retained inventory, interfaces or transport network throughout scope.
families.novelty: Electrical and nanotube/epoxy sources overlap descriptors; failed final imaging does not establish absence or novelty. No descriptor values are fixed.
families.obviousness: Changes to dispersion/interface/geometry require supported processing and expectation; no general reinforcing/transport result follows.
families.definiteness: Resolve actual descriptor constraints versus descriptive specification; constituent data need not establish final composite geometry.
families.action: Record stock categories, retention, interface unknowns and objective geometry in selected conditional examples.

families.name: Layers and spatial density-weighted inventory
families.enablement: Layer and field definitions do not supply fabrication, densities, diffusion/interface stability or spatial assay.
families.novelty: Layered/gradient article sources require specific searching; aggregate elemental equality does not disclose a particular spatial field.
families.obviousness: Fabrication/spatial modification rationale and expectation must be selected; scalar composition equivalence cannot substitute.
families.definiteness: 179 requires layer order/dimensions; 180 requires x_i(r,t) and density-weighted whole inventory. Atomic and mass density weights must follow the selected basis.
families.action: Print specimen region/time and weighting rule; keep local and whole assays separate, with discontinuous interfaces allowed by an explicit model.

families.name: Single phase or identified multiphase
families.enablement: Phase identity/coexistence and quantities need individual support. A source host plus unresolved residue cannot be declared a binary whole-product single phase.
families.novelty: Known one-/multi-phase materials are comparator targets; 181 and 182 are separate direct dependents and should not be combined.
families.obviousness: Actual assemblage/phase-selection modification and coexistence expectation need phase-specific evidence.
families.definiteness: 181 states one phase for the selected elemental inventory; 182 identifies each phase. Clarify phase completeness and measurement convention.
families.action: Use phase-profile convex-hull constraints and explicitly include retained surfaces/solvent/other phases in the boundary.

families.name: Volume and void fractions in composite
families.enablement: Additive-volume conversion needs applicable densities/state/volume allocation; unknown voids are not zero.
families.novelty: Electrical component mass/volume discussion does not alone supply complete void fraction or all stated conventions.
families.obviousness: An actual void/geometry processing contribution needs supported source comparison and expectation; volume relabeling alone may be descriptive.
families.definiteness: Inherits 178 and 1. Constituent/void volumes share an identified denominator separate from elemental atomic fractions.
families.action: Print additive-model assumptions and nonadditivity/unknown-void rejection; do not infer elemental fractions from component loading.

families.name: Targets, uncertainty/sampling and feed/product/local separation
families.enablement: Uncertainty bounds/covariance are conditional models, not actual calibrated assay; stage separation does not ensure controlled retention.
families.novelty: Many scientific reports distinguish nominal, feed and product quantities; compare the actual informational or functional arrangement. Missing reported uncertainty is not a physical distinction.
families.obviousness: Routine characterization/stage recording needs actual source/rationale before an obviousness result; no new material result is shown.
families.definiteness: 184 permits measurement uncertainty OR tolerance with sampling; 185 is separate and does not inherit 184/178. Uncertainty cannot relax claim 1's exact-zero condition.
families.action: Keep deterministic bounds versus confidence intervals and actual retained quantities versus feed/local values explicit.

families.name: Complete material record construction and support enumeration
families.enablement: Recording unresolved fields is practicable and supported; numerical generators alone populate only a subset. Making the indexed material is not a method step.
families.novelty: Existing scientific records contain much of the field content, but no complete earlier arrangement of positive target assignment and field-specific status operations is established in this audit. JSON format is not claimed.
families.obviousness: Record aggregation/normalization/status selection are search targets; no cited combination rationale proves the whole workflow obvious.
families.definiteness: Define allowed support/basis, field granularity and unresolved-field handling. 187 adds every increasing tuple and label status, not every manufactured species.
families.action: Include a complete worked record with explicit unknowns and a lazy/finite export boundary; tie any future technical improvement to actually disclosed operations.

families.definiteness: 188 successive unrestricted denominators requires lazy infinite procedure; 189 is finite but immense; 190 rejects normalization/positivity failures.
families.action: State prefix/iterator semantics, termination per finite denominator, exact strings, error outputs and full-record field preservation.

families.name: Feasibility and numerical witness methods
families.enablement: Exact arithmetic supports numerical construction. 191 can encounter no positive witness after a nonnegative witness; 192/193 give stronger stated feasibility branches. Physical preparation is not a claimed step.
families.novelty: Residual allocation, positivity and integer-bound feasibility are concrete algorithm comparator targets; no complete prior algorithm chart was performed here.
families.obviousness: Compare the precise greedy/epsilon/grid constructions and parent record operations against algorithms, rather than infer inventiveness from correct mathematics.
families.definiteness: 191's rejection when U has zero or the unique lower vector has zero is implicit. 192 assumes k=selected support size; explicitly introducing that definition could improve clarity. 193 already selects a k-component box, which supplies contextual k meaning; no missing-k defect is asserted there.
families.action: Add no-positive-witness rejection and explicit k definition; preserve separation of preliminary witness, final positive target and rejected record.

families.name: Independent particle-system record
families.enablement: Record construction is distinct from creating/confining arbitrary particle systems. Selected identity tables do not populate all claimed fields.
families.novelty: Particle catalog/laboratory record systems are comparator targets; a finite selected identity extraction does not show all earlier record operations or novelty.
families.obviousness: Need actual data-system/particle-record sources and comparison of construction-level accounting; no new physical particle is implied.
families.definiteness: 'Construction level' and 'same inventory' need objective examples; no particle/containing-composite double counting is the actual limitation.
families.action: Give one complete model-qualified record including unknown fields and an explicit counted-level exclusion example.

families.name: Host-dependent excitation record
families.enablement: Host, driver, state and lifetime/observable can be recorded; no new excitation or arbitrary stable quasiparticle mixture is claimed.
families.novelty: Established excitation records are plausible sources; no earlier complete arrangement of 194+195 has been charted here.
families.obviousness: Host-record customization needs concrete sources and functional difference; lack of an experiment does not resolve method obviousness.
families.definiteness: Lifetime OR linewidth is an alternative; conversion requires assumptions and is not recited. Host-dependent excitation is not a new elemental label.
families.action: Use supported host/observable/lifetime model and separate energy shares from elemental fractions.

families.name: Hypothetical model-qualified particle record
families.enablement: Status/assumption/search fields can be recorded without producing the hypothetical entity; conservation/model validity remains separate.
families.novelty: Hypothesis/search catalogs are concrete comparator targets. Unsupported-property suppression is a record policy, not proof of undiscovered particle novelty.

families.action: Provide one hypothetical record with explicit missing production/observation and no fabricated measured values.

families.name: Property scenario and credible alternative recording
families.enablement: A conditional test and mechanism can be recorded without experiment; no universal model/sign or actual property magnitude is supplied.

families.name: Four evidence labels with provenance

later_claim_scenarios.concrete_example: A later claim to the source-type TiO2(B) nanosheet arrangement, adding an identified exposed surface or morphology requirement. This is an illustrative comparison, not an actual later patent claim.

disclosed_features.feature: Selected TiO2(B) host identity and nominal Ti:O=1:2 formula with nanosheet/phase characterization.
disclosed_features.evidence: ESTABLISHED attributed report; nominal formula is not an exact whole-product assay.

disclosed_features.feature: Selected precursor/processing/isolation context and limits in the curated source record.
disclosed_features.evidence: ESTABLISHED attribution with source-local gaps retained.

disclosed_features.feature: (1/3,2/3) ideal atom accounting and phase/retention constraints.
disclosed_features.evidence: CALCULATED or PROPOSED present models; not newly measured source data.

missing_features: Any later exact complete retained binary inventory, purity, isotope state, morphology value or surface requirement not actually established by the selected source.
Source-specific precursor qualifications and all actual additional later-claim limitations.
Reference qualification against an actual effective filing date and exceptions.
later_claim_scenarios.possible_section_102_argument: If one qualifying enabled reference supplies the source-type arrangement and every actual later limitation, expressly or necessarily, it can anticipate the later claim and an encompassing genus. A missing exact product, structure or state limit cannot be filled by nominal formula alone.
later_claim_scenarios.possible_section_103_argument: For a remaining surface, morphology, purity or state difference, identify applicable teachings, a reason to select/modify and reasonable expected success. Retention or phase uncertainty is not replaced by a generic normalization argument.
unresolved_questions: What exact later claim is compared?
Which specimen/observation boundary and atomic or mass basis apply?
Are additional features expressly taught or necessarily inherent?
Does the reference enable the selected arrangement with skilled knowledge?
Which filing/publication dates and exceptions govern?

disclosed_features.feature: A selected TiO2(B) source-associated host and nominal stoichiometry.

disclosed_features.evidence: CALCULATED bookkeeping; reaction feasibility and phase selection remain PROPOSED/UNSUPPORTED.

disclosed_features.feature: General structural/site/charge-compensation requirements and phase-mixture limits.
disclosed_features.evidence: Descriptive constraints and conditional models, not every phase or vacancy structure.

missing_features: The selected retained delta range with actual precursor/process applicability and controlled loss/ingress.

A source teaching or necessary result connecting the earlier B-phase example to the newly specified state.
later_claim_scenarios.possible_section_102_argument: A generic Ti/O domain and one B-phase example do not automatically disclose the selected changed ratio plus rutile structure. Anticipation could apply only if a qualifying reference specifically supplies the actual arrangement or a sufficiently bounded immediately envisaged combination, including enablement.
later_claim_scenarios.possible_section_103_argument: Compare an actual reduction/defect/phase-selection teaching and range overlap, identify a reason to select the claimed interval/state and an expected workable result, and consider competing phases or contrary evidence. An atom-balance equation supplies no thermodynamic success expectation.
unresolved_questions: Which phase/site model is actually claimed?
Is delta a retained-product, nominal host or feed quantity?

What source-supported route and expectation address those differences?
Are ranges result-effective and is any contrary evidence tied to the claim?

later_claim_scenarios.scenario: A physical species selected from the enormous support/rational catalog

disclosed_features.feature: Every increasing support address and unrestricted positive rational normalized domain.
disclosed_features.evidence: CALCULATED numerical definitions and incremental enumeration.

disclosed_features.feature: One selected source-associated metallic-glass preparation/diagnostic context and principal target.
disclosed_features.evidence: ESTABLISHED source attribution; present fine boxes and an added-element model are separate calculations.

disclosed_features.feature: Conditional mixture, thermal-path and precision models with explicit limits.
disclosed_features.evidence: CALCULATED/PROPOSED; no universally applicable glass network or cooling law.

missing_features: The selected combined physical species: supported retained vector, particular local order/network, usable preparation and relevant state.
A source-specific disclosure or adequately bounded preference directing the skilled person to that physical combination.
Any complete source teaching of the claimed tolerance, thermal state or use, and qualifying chronology.
later_claim_scenarios.possible_section_102_argument: An enabled specifically disclosed species can anticipate a broad genus containing it. In the reverse comparison, membership in an enormous mathematical catalog does not necessarily disclose the selected physical species. A clear named species is not hidden by list length, but at-once-envisaged combinations require a factual bounded-disclosure assessment.
later_claim_scenarios.possible_section_103_argument: Find supported selection reasons, usable route and expected success for the chosen physical combination. A massive menu whose members differ greatly does not supply those facts merely by enumeration; actual range/selection teachings and contrary evidence need review.
unresolved_questions: Is the later claim only a numerical address or a physical structure/state/use combination?
What exact combined species is specifically taught or immediately envisaged?
